d: Union Home Minister Amit Shah, alongside Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel, inaugurated and laid foundation stones for development projects worth ₹1,400 crore in Ahmedabad. Reflecting on his political roots at Ramapir No Tekro, Shah highlighted the transformation of the region, where in-situ housing complexes, smart schools, and modern civic infrastructure now serve over 55,000 residents. Shah also unveiled a major anti-drug initiative, setting a deadline of December 31, 2028, to make Gujarat completely drug-free—a year ahead of the national 2029 target.
